# Surface

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

An off-screen RGBA drawing target. Create one with `Surface.New()` or decode an image with `Surface.Load()`.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#graphics).

## Blit

```PPL
Surface.Blit(Surface source, INTEGER destinationX, INTEGER destinationY) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Alpha-composites the source surface at the destination pixel coordinates.

## BlitRect

```PPL
Surface.BlitRect(Surface source, INTEGER sourceX, INTEGER sourceY, INTEGER width, INTEGER height, INTEGER destinationX, INTEGER destinationY) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Alpha-composites a source pixel rectangle at the destination pixel coordinates.

## Clear

```PPL
Surface.Clear(UNSIGNED rgba) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Fills the entire surface with a packed `0xRRGGBBAA` color.

## DrawRect

```PPL
Surface.DrawRect(INTEGER x, INTEGER y, INTEGER width, INTEGER height, UNSIGNED rgba) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Outlines the pixel rectangle with a packed `0xRRGGBBAA` color.

## FillRect

```PPL
Surface.FillRect(INTEGER x, INTEGER y, INTEGER width, INTEGER height, UNSIGNED rgba) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Fills the pixel rectangle with a packed `0xRRGGBBAA` color.

## Free

```PPL
Surface.Free() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Releases the surface and its resident pixel memory.

## GetPixel

```PPL
Surface.GetPixel(INTEGER x, INTEGER y) UNSIGNED
```

Instance function.

Returns the packed `0xRRGGBBAA` color at the zero-based pixel coordinates.

## Height

`Surface.Height: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

The read-only surface dimension in pixels.

## Load

```PPL
Surface.Load(STRING file) Surface
```

Static function.

Decodes an image file into a surface. The source file is limited to 32 MiB.

## New

```PPL
Surface.New(INTEGER width, INTEGER height) Surface
```

Static function.

Creates a transparent surface with the requested pixel dimensions. Surfaces are limited to 2048 by 2048 pixels.

## Pin

```PPL
Surface.Pin() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Uploads an immutable JPEG-XL client buffer. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends `APC SyncTERM:C;LoadJXLBlob;B=buffer;base64 ST`. Requires the JPEG-XL backend and SyncTERM/CTerm client-buffer support.

## Present

```PPL
Surface.Present() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Presents the entire surface at the current terminal position. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** Sixel sends a Sixel DCS image. JPEG XL uses `APC SyncTERM:C;DrawJXLBlob;DX=x;DY=y;base64 ST`, or uploads with `…;S;cacheName;base64 ST` and draws with `…;DrawJXL;DX=x;DY=y;cacheName ST`.

## PresentAt

```PPL
Surface.PresentAt(INTEGER column, INTEGER row) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Presents the entire surface at the given 1-based text column and row. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** Sixel sends `CSI ? 1070 h`, saves with `ESC 7`, moves with `CSI row ; column H`, sends Sixel DCS, restores with `ESC 8`, then sends `CSI ? 1070 l`. JPEG XL converts cells to pixels and uses SyncTERM `DrawJXLBlob`/`DrawJXL` APC.

## PresentRect

```PPL
Surface.PresentRect(INTEGER sourceX, INTEGER sourceY, INTEGER sourceWidth, INTEGER sourceHeight, [INTEGER column], [INTEGER row], [INTEGER destinationWidth], [INTEGER destinationHeight], [INTEGER flip]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Presents a source pixel rectangle with optional destination, scaling and flip. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** identity output may use Sixel DCS. Scaling or flipping requires JPEG XL and SyncTERM/CTerm `DrawJXLBlob` or `DrawJXL` APC with `DX`, `DY`, and transform options.

## SetPixel

```PPL
Surface.SetPixel(INTEGER x, INTEGER y, UNSIGNED rgba) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Writes a packed `0xRRGGBBAA` color at the zero-based pixel coordinates.

## Unpin

```PPL
Surface.Unpin() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Releases the server-side association with the pinned JPEG-XL client buffer. No terminal sequence is sent; the client may retain its cached buffer.

## Valid

`Surface.Valid: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether this surface refers to a live image. Resource failures return an invalid surface and set `Error.Last()`.

## Width

`Surface.Width: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

The read-only surface dimension in pixels.
